subject: HTML UI - Not Working on Initial Loading

messages.author: b98fce6926d16a31
messages.subject: HTML UI - Not Working on Initial Loading
parts:
I have a project I recently switched from using a UI.R file to an index.html file so I could make some changes I couldn't figure out just using the ui file - I simply copied the source code from a browser running with the ui file to populate my initial index.html file and everything seemed to be working well until this morning.

This morning when I reloaded RStudio and tried to launch my shiny app (still using the index.html ui file) the app opened but parts were missing and controls were unresponseive. I pulled my original ui.R file back into the project and ran it once (worked fine but obviously lacked my alterations) and then dropped it out again and my index.html file once again worked on it's own.

Anyone know if it is some loading dependency I can work around?

Thanks for any help!

messages.subject: Re: HTML UI - Not Working on Initial Loading
parts: Thanks for mentioning the console! That lead me to the answer - I needed to copy a number of .js and .css files into my www folder and update the references in the index file. It looks like it worked when I loaded the UI.r file before trying the index version because the libraries were already loaded into the browser cache!
